name: rswrlbp
description: RuneScape Wiki / RuneLite Best Practices — a pre-review for OSRS plugins, apps and extensions: what a tool costs the services it reads, and whether it gates anything behind payment.

plugins.name: osrs-plugin-review
plugins.description: Reviews OSRS plugin, app and extension code for API etiquette and Plugin Hub readiness: per-item request loops, blocked User-Agents, missing caching, polling faster than the data changes, expensive parser queries where a bulk dump exists, and features gated behind payment on non-commercially-licensed data.
